update_policy: Only advance a case to a stronger evidence stage when a fresh public source directly supports that stage. Do not infer release from merge, implementation from intent, or endorsement of an entire theory from a bounded case.

canonical_theory_context.relationship: This evidence index is an applied/verification layer for bounded structural distinctions. It is not a separate theory system.
